0022600184.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game winning streak) visit the San Antonio Spurs (4-2, on a four-game winning streak) in the Mavericks' 8th game of the season, with Dallas 7th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, and San Antonio 5th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, also 2 games back. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Mavericks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 122-106 loss in Dallas on October 24, and they lost all four meetings with the Spurs in 2025-26.
